A Walk in the Sky

8 November, 2023

Why is it that
feelings only
feel real
when directed to someone?

Why does music
make you yearn
for having
a lover to yearn?

Why can't love,
like clouds,
just exist?

Wish we could love
and lust
and ache
and envy
as aimlessly
as an evening walk.

Wish we could go
for a walk in the sky.

- Abdullah Alam
